visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian man with black hair, earrings, and a gold necklace sits on a gray fabric couch, wearing a navy and white raglan shirt and camouflage patterned pants. He looks down at a white ceramic mug on a light wood coffee table; a cockroach sticker is visible on the mug. The scene is set in a brightly lit indoor living room. (2) A close-up shot reveals the white mug on the table more clearly, focusing on a realistic cockroach graphic. The man's tattooed left arm and Apple Watch are visible in the foreground. (3) The man is shown against a plain white background, reacting with an extreme, exaggerated scream, his mouth wide open and eyes squinted. Animated white motion lines burst around him to emphasize shock. (4) A delivery man in a blue cap, blue vest, and white gloves appears sitting next to the original man on the couch, holding a cardboard box and a yellow spray can. (5) Large text overlays the screen as the delivery man smiles at the camera. (6) The man looks confused, holding his mug and gesturing with his hands. (7) Scene shifts to a bathroom with beige tiles. The man is brushing his teeth, then looks at the camera and screams with the same dramatic white lines and motion effects. (8) A blue lightning effect flashes as the delivery man appears in the bathroom, holding a box and a tube of skincare/toothpaste. (9) The man sits on a toilet in the bathroom, reaching for a white toilet paper holder which is completely empty. (10) He screams again in the bathroom setting. (11) The delivery man appears with a box of tissues. (12) Scene changes to an office-like setting. The man is frustrated while using a blue tablet, tapping the screen repeatedly. (13) He screams while pulling at his hair in frustration. (14) The delivery man appears outside a glass balcony door, holding a package. (15) The man looks shocked at the delivery man's entry point. (16) The man is handed a new iPad from a Coupang box and looks delighted. (17) A screen recording shows the Coupang app interface on the tablet, featuring various product listings, prices, and a 618 promotion banner. (18) The two men sit on the couch together, holding the iPad and smiling as the final slogan appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a jaunty, upbeat pop-style BGM characterized by a bright piano melody and clean electronic percussion. The mix is studio-quality with a high signal-to-noise ratio. A professional acoustic atmosphere prevails with no ambient interference. (2) A sharp digital 'ding' sound effect, with a high spectral centroid, pierces the mix to punctuate the appearance of the first text overlay. The BGM continues its steady rhythmic pulse in the background. (3) A sudden, high-arousal male scream erupts with significant intensity, showing a jagged frequency response and high-frequency dominance. This is followed by a comical impact SFX that mimics a cartoonish bonk. (4) A rapid 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the camera cuts to a new scene. The BGM remains consistent, maintaining the energetic pace. (5) Another 'ding' SFX marks the delivery man's appearance, followed by a dry percussive hit. (6) A short pause in vocal activity occurs as the creator looks confused, with only the BGM piano loop audible. (7) A loud vocalization of shock returns, accompanied by a vibrating comic-style SFX. (8) A synthesized electric zap SFX with high spectral flux triggers as the delivery man appears again. (9) A melodic, positive notification chime sounds as the man receives a new device. (10) A male narrator with a professional broadcast tone begins a fast-paced delivery, explaining promotional details with high articulation clarity. (11) The video concludes with both male voices speaking a brand slogan in unison, followed by a final bright digital chime.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Sudden Delivery Solution -> Problem -> Sudden Delivery Solution -> Product Highlight -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Coupang shopping app and its 'Rocket Delivery' service by humorously illustrating how it solves everyday inconveniences instantly, followed by a detailed explanation of current sales and membership benefits.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The delivery man is wearing a brand uniform, holding branded boxes, and the second half of the video is a direct commercial for the Coupang app's 618 promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy 'meme' editing style with exaggerated reactions and frequent sound effects to keep viewer engagement high before transitioning into a standard promotional segment.
